Its guide is reproduced below so you don't need to fetch it: # Trama Design System > Private academic & social matching for university students. > **Institutional prestige meets modern networking.** Never dating-app. Trama connects ~1,000 students at **Anáhuac Oaxaca** through multidimensional compatibility — academic goals, research interests, and personal affinities — rather than public feeds or likes. The product is intentionally closed, editorial, and focused on *intellectual* connection: collaborators, study partners, research pairs, and friendships built on shared pursuits. The design language balances **institutional prestige** with **modern mobile fluidity**: editorial typography, breathable tonal surfaces, orange as the single signal color, and zero dating-app visual DNA (no hearts, no swipes, no feed). --- ## Sources This system was built from a written design brief only — **no Figma, codebase, or screenshots were attached**. All component behavior, screen composition, and visual decisions below trace to the brief's color tokens, type scale, and rules. Anything not explicitly in the brief (illustration style, icon set, specific copy samples, additional screens beyond the five) is flagged in CAVEATS at the end of this file. If/when source files land, re-attach them and this system can be reconciled against the real product. --- ## Index | File | What's in it | |---|---| | `colors_and_type.css` | All CSS custom properties: colors (light + dark), type scale, semantic type classes, radii, spacing, shadows, glass, network texture | | `fonts/` | `Manrope-Variable.woff2`, `Inter-Variable.woff2` — self-hosted | | `assets/` | Logo, app icon, network-pattern SVG, illustrations | | `ui_kits/mobile/` | Full mobile UI kit — 5 screens + component library | | `preview/` | Design System tab cards (type, color, spacing, components, brand) | | `SKILL.md` | Cross-compatible skill front-matter for Agent Skills / Claude Code | --- ## Content Fundamentals **Language.** Spanish-first (Anáhuac Oaxaca is a Mexican institution). English appears only for internal system labels when Spanish would be awkward ("Bookmark", "Study Together" is acceptable). When in doubt, Spanish wins. Voice uses **tú**, never **usted** — warm and peer-to-peer, not institutional. **Tone.** Editorial and measured. Half-way between university prospectus ("Conectamos mentes afines") and contemporary social product ("Ya hay 3 personas en tu semestre que comparten tu interés en neurociencia computacional"). Never breathless, never marketing-slang. **Casing.** Sentence case everywhere. No ALL-CAPS buttons, no Title Case Headers. Section labels stay sentence case too ("Intereses académicos", not "Intereses Académicos"). The ONE exception is the logo wordmark. **Specific copy examples:** - Primary CTA copy: *"Continuar"*, *"Conectar"*, *"Estudiar juntos"*, *"Guardar perfil"* — verbs, never "Submit" or "OK". - Empty-state copy is encouraging and specific, never generic: > "Aún no tienes conexiones. Activa tus intereses en **Descubrir** y te > mostraremos compañeros compatibles esta semana." - Compatibility readouts are descriptive, not numeric-only: > "Match académico 87% — comparten 4 cursos y 2 líneas de investigación." - Context tags on connections quote the *source* of the match: > *"Conectados vía Cálculo Avanzado"*, *"Grupo de lectura · Filosofía de la mente"*. - Error messages are calm and helpful: *"No pudimos guardar tus cambios. Revisa tu conexión e intenta de nuevo."* — never "Oops!" or "Uh oh". **Pronouns.** "Tú" to the user. "Nosotros" for Trama itself, used sparingly ("Te mostramos…", "Trama te recomienda…" — prefer the second-person phrasing). Never "usuarios" in user-facing copy; always "estudiantes" or "compañeros". **Emoji.** Not used. Unicode arrows (→) and middle-dots (·) are used as typographic seasoning ("Matemáticas · 5° semestre"). That's the limit. **Numbers and data.** Percentages are written *"87%"* without decimals. Times are 24-hour *"14:30"*. Semester uses ordinal *"5° semestre"*. **Vibe in one line.** *"Una biblioteca a las 10pm, con personas interesantes presentándose."* --- ## Visual Foundations ### Color Orange is the single signal color across the whole system — **#AB2D00 Primary** in light mode, **#FF7851 Primary** in dark mode. Every interactive affordance, CTA, and selected state uses it. The CTA gradient is the only gradient allowed: `linear-gradient(135deg, Primary → Primary Fixed Dim)`. No cyan, no green, no purple. Secondary Container (a cool desaturated blue-grey, **#D7E4EC** light / **#1A2C38** dark) is the *only* non-orange accent, and only for academic chips in their unselected state. ### Surface system — "paper on stone" Elevation comes from **stacked surface tones**, never shadows or borders. A card uses `surface-container-lowest`; it sits on a page using `surface-container` or `surface-dim`. The delta between the two is what reads as depth. In light mode the values span #FAFAFA → #E0E3E4 (4 steps); dark mode #0A0C0D → #2C3133. ### Typography - **Manrope** for display/headlines at 600/700 — geometric, modern, high x-height. Used at 22px minimum, usually 28px+. - **Inter** for body and labels at 400/500 — optical size handles 12–16px cleanly. - Display MD (44px) reserved for hero moments — onboarding step titles, empty-state headings. Never stacked more than one per screen. - Label SM (12px, tracking +0.4px) is *sentence case*, not uppercase — preserving the editorial voice. ### Spacing & layout - 8px vertical rhythm. Every gap, padding, and margin is a multiple of 8 (with 4px only for icon-to-label intra-component spacing). - **24px minimum container padding**, always. 32px+ between major sections. - **Asymmetric layout.** Text always left-aligns. Imagery bleeds off the right edge of cards — never centered, never fully boxed. This enforces the editorial feel. ### Backgrounds - Full-bleed hero photos on profile details, fading down to `surface-dim` via a single-stop opacity mask (not a multi-color gradient). - `surface-dim` regions (e.g. onboarding background, empty states) carry the **network texture** — dots + connecting lines at 4–6% opacity via SVG. This is the system's one repeating pattern and reinforces the connectivity theme. - No photographic textures, no hand-drawn illustrations, no noise. Clean surfaces. ### Animation - Movement is **restrained and editorial**. Default easing `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`, duration 180–240ms for state changes, 320ms for sheet/modal enter. - Interactions fade, they don't bounce. Scale transforms cap at 0.98 on press. - Page transitions are subtle cross-fades with an 8px Y translation, never slides. ### Hover / press states - **Hover:** background transitions from `surface-container-lowest` → `surface-bright`. No opacity fades, no underline animations. - **Press:** background steps *down* one tonal rung (e.g. lowest → low), plus a 0.98 scale. CTAs dim the gradient by 8%. - **Focus:** 2px outline in Primary at 40% opacity, offset 2px. No system blue. ### Borders - **None for sectioning.** Zero. This is the brand's defining rule. - The only border permitted is the **ghost border** — `outline-variant` at 15% opacity — on form inputs in their resting state, and only when the surface shift alone isn't enough definition. Felt, not seen. ### Shadows - **Ambient only**, and *only* on modals, bottom sheets, and FABs. Blur 24–40px, opacity 4–8%, tinted with `on-surface`. - Cards, list items, and chips carry **zero shadow**, ever. Elevation is tonal. ### Glass / blur - The top nav and filter-chip strip use `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` + `surface` at 78–85% opacity. This is where transparency lives — nowhere else. - Modals and bottom sheets use solid `surface-container-low`, not glass. ### Corner radii - Cards: **24px**. Inputs: **12px**. Chips and buttons: **pill / 9999px**. - Hero surfaces, bottom sheets: **32px top-only**. - Full-bleed backgrounds (profile photo, app background): **0** — the only place sharp corners are allowed. ### Imagery - Student photos are warm, natural, slightly desaturated — 3200K white balance feel. No heavy filters, no b&w. Always cropped to leave room for the right-edge bleed. - Avatars on list rows are **48px** circles. Profile hero photos are **390px wide × 320px tall** full-bleed. ### Cards Every card looks like this: - `surface-container-lowest` fill - 24px border radius - 24px internal padding (20px on compact list cards) - NO border, NO shadow - Hover → `surface-bright` - Contents left-aligned; any imagery bleeds right ### What Trama does *not* look like - No heart icons, no like counts, no "super-like" equivalents. - No swipe-card stacks; discovery is a vertical staggered list. - No multi-color gradients (pink→purple, teal→blue, etc.). - No 1px dividers between list rows. - No system-blue links or focus rings. - No emoji in UI chrome. --- ## Iconography Trama uses **[Lucide](https://lucide.dev)** via CDN (`lucide@0.454.0`), at **1.5px stroke weight**, 24px default size. Rationale: geometric, thin-line icons match Manrope's geometry; the set has the exact affordances Trama needs (`Bookmark`, `Users`, `BookOpen`, `GraduationCap`, `Microscope`, `MessageSquare`) and explicitly **does not include** hearts, likes, or flames that would read as dating-app. > **Substitution flagged:** No icon set was specified in the brief. Lucide is > my choice — swap via the CDN href in each HTML file if you prefer Phosphor, > Heroicons, or a custom set. **Approved Trama icon mappings** (use these verbs, never dating-app verbs): - **Save/favorite** → `Bookmark` (never `Heart`). - **Match/study-together** → `Users` or `UsersRound`. - **Connect** → `MessageSquare` or `Handshake`. - **Research interest** → `Microscope` / `BookOpen` / `GraduationCap`. - **Discover** → `Compass`. - **Groups** → `UsersRound`. - **Profile** → `UserRound`. **Emoji** is never used. **Unicode typography** is used sparingly: `→` for inline directionals, `·` as a soft separator, `°` for ordinal semester numbers (*"5° semestre"*). No ™, ®, or other ornamentation. The only brand SVGs live in `assets/`: - `logo.svg` — the Trama wordmark - `logo-mark.svg` — the weave icon, used as app icon and monogram - `network-pattern.svg` — the dot-and-line texture for surface-dim regions --- ## CAVEATS — please help iterate Things I invented or guessed because no source materials were attached. **Tell me where I'm wrong and I'll correct.** 1. **Logo + app-icon mark.** I drew a minimal "weave" mark from the word *Trama* ("weft" in Spanish textile terminology). If there's a real logo, drop it in `assets/` and I'll rebuild every card that uses it. 2. **Icon set.** Lucide via CDN. If the real product uses Phosphor or a bespoke set, I'll swap. 3. **Student photo placeholders.** I used light grey blocks with initials. Real photography direction (warm, editorial, shallow DOF) is described in the README but not demonstrated. 4. **Illustration for the Matches empty state.** Line-art network drawn with SVG. If there's a real illustration system, drop files in and I'll replace. 5. **Specific copy.** All Spanish strings are plausible but invented. A pass from whoever owns product voice would tighten them. 6. **Anáhuac Oaxaca branding context.** I did not import university colors or seals — Trama is presented as its own product, not co-branded. --- ## How to use this system ```html

Pixel-level recreations of Trama's five core mobile screens at **390 × 844**
(iPhone 14 base). All screens share tokens from `../../colors_and_type.css`
and the screen-layout styles in `ui_kit.css`.
